name: playbench
description: Every game-dev loop for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and more): one-page design, build in small playtested slices, bot and agent playtests on your real build, balance sweeps and sims, iterate from evidence, human playtest logs and player feedback, and itch/Steam/web shipping that blocks undisclosed AI art. Humans own the fun and every gate.
